title: How often does a sequential walk miss?

prereqs.why: The whole answer turns on the fact that a cache fetches a line and not a byte.
You need to be able to turn a stride in elements into a stride in bytes.

hints: How many 4-byte `int`s fit in one 64-byte line?
The first access to a line misses and pays for the fetch. What happens on the accesses to the other elements that arrived in that same line?
